lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (α : Type) (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∩ C) ⊆ C := by
  apply Set.Subset.trans
  apply Set.inter_subset_right
  apply Set.inter_subset_right

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
